title: Kenworth T610 FUPS Polished High Tensile Road Train Bullbar #5
description: Kenworth T610 Custom Built high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS compliant Road Train Bullbar. 76mm diameter high tensile tube welded into drilled uprights for maximum strength, no butt welds resulting in maximum protection. Heavy duty high tensile box uprights with internal welds for maximum strength and custom designed heavy duty main channel with lower skirt. Fixed Road Train signs with removable heavy duty covers. Heavy duty hi-tensile aluminium backing plate with 35mm tow pin. Driving light mounts fitted to customer requirements. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
